changes.title: feat(web): a minimap on every problem page, not only the coordinate-bearing instances

commit.message:
task(web): plan a minimap for every problem page

Covers the 17 EXPLICIT pages with no image: 5 publish DISPLAY_DATA_SECTION the
generator never reads, and 12 publish no coordinates, so their layout has to be
derived from the distance matrix and labelled as derived. Also plans the
large-instance page weight (pla85900 is 6.2 MB of inline SVG).
